source: CISI Vols. 1–2 plate photographs, local research copies (corpora/downloads/cisi_image_layer)
license_basis: Transcription facts (sign sequences + printed metadata) produced by this program from in-copyright local research copies of CISI Vol. 1 (Joshi & Parpola 1987) and Vol. 2 (Shah & Parpola 1991); dataset published CC BY 4.0 per owner adjudication 2026-10-09 (spec 023 §11 ask 4); plate images are never published.
text_rule: Impression-primary orientation (spec 023 §5.1, owner value at freeze); seal-face sequence is the derived reversal.
unit_rule: One record per CISI object (volume-scoped printed ID); multi-face objects concatenate inscribed faces in A-then-B order with per-token photo attribution.

upstream_lineage.derived_from: Original transcription from CISI plate photographs
upstream_lineage.notes: Not derived from Holdat, ICIT, or the mayig layer; passes were blinded (spec 023 §5.5). Sign identifications use the published Mahadevan/Parpola lists (spec 023 §8 limits apply).

inscriptions.damage_notes: Clay sealing cracked through. The only per-photo crop supplied is face B, the cord-marked back of the sealing, showing only rough clay, horizontal cord/string striations and a crack - no glyph or glyph slot anywhere on it. Face A carries four faint seal impressions (A 1-4) visible only at plate resolution on the page image; each shows at most a faint animal and one or two vertical trace marks, too faint to segment or identify, and no A crops were provided, so the object is untranscribable from the supplied photos. Pass_a additionally listed 'K-88 A 1-4' among its photos; that is a plate area, not a provided object photo, and the ruled record rests on K-88 B.
